question.en: Which fruit floats in water because it is about 25% air?
question.ms: Buah manakah terapung di air kerana kira-kira 25% daripadanya adalah udara?

funFact.en: Apples float because they contain many air pockets inside.
funFact.ms: Epal terapung kerana mempunyai banyak poket udara di dalamnya.

question.en: Which animal's fingerprints are almost identical to humans?
question.ms: Haiwan manakah mempunyai cap jari hampir sama dengan manusia?

funFact.en: Koala fingerprints are so similar they can confuse forensic investigators.
funFact.ms: Cap jari koala sangat mirip sehingga boleh mengelirukan penyiasat forensik.

question.en: Which planet rains diamonds due to extreme pressure?
question.ms: Planet manakah dipercayai mengalami hujan berlian akibat tekanan ekstrem?

funFact.en: Scientists believe carbon in Neptune's atmosphere can compress into diamonds.
funFact.ms: Saintis percaya karbon di atmosfera Neptun boleh termampat menjadi berlian.

question.en: Which country has more lakes than the rest of the world combined?
question.ms: Negara manakah mempunyai lebih banyak tasik daripada seluruh dunia digabungkan?

funFact.en: Canada has over 2 million lakes.
funFact.ms: Kanada mempunyai lebih daripada 2 juta tasik.

question.en: Which animal can survive without its head for several days?
question.ms: Haiwan manakah boleh hidup tanpa kepala selama beberapa hari?

funFact.en: Cockroaches breathe through body openings and don't rely on their heads to survive temporarily.
funFact.ms: Lipas bernafas melalui liang badan dan tidak bergantung kepada kepala untuk hidup sementara.

question.en: Which metal can melt in your hand due to low melting point?
question.ms: Logam manakah boleh cair di tangan kerana takat lebur rendah?

funFact.en: Gallium melts at about 29.7°C.
funFact.ms: Gallium mencair pada kira-kira 29.7°C.

question.en: Which part of the human body contains no blood vessels?
question.ms: Bahagian badan manusia manakah tidak mempunyai saluran darah?

funFact.en: The cornea gets oxygen directly from the air.
funFact.ms: Kornea mendapat oksigen terus dari udara.

question.en: Which animal can sleep for up to three years?
question.ms: Haiwan manakah boleh tidur sehingga tiga tahun?

funFact.en: Snails may hibernate for years during dry conditions.
funFact.ms: Siput boleh berhibernasi selama bertahun-tahun semasa keadaan kering.

question.en: Which fruit is technically a berry according to botany?
question.ms: Buah manakah secara teknikalnya adalah beri menurut botani?

funFact.en: Botanically, bananas qualify as berries.
funFact.ms: Secara botani, pisang diklasifikasikan sebagai beri.

question.en: Which animal has three hearts?
question.ms: Haiwan manakah mempunyai tiga jantung?

funFact.en: Two hearts pump blood to the gills while one pumps it to the body.
funFact.ms: Dua jantung mengepam darah ke insang dan satu ke badan.

question.en: Which continent has no native ants?
question.ms: Benua manakah tidak mempunyai semut asli?

funFact.en: Antarctica is too cold for ants to survive naturally.
funFact.ms: Antartika terlalu sejuk untuk semut hidup secara semula jadi.

question.en: Which bird can fly backwards?
question.ms: Burung manakah boleh terbang ke belakang?

funFact.en: Hummingbirds hover and even fly backward.
funFact.ms: Hummingbird boleh melayang dan terbang ke belakang.

question.en: Which animal has blue blood due to copper-based molecules?
question.ms: Haiwan manakah mempunyai darah biru kerana molekul berasaskan tembaga?

funFact.en: Its blood is used in medical testing.
funFact.ms: Darahnya digunakan dalam ujian perubatan.

question.en: Which country invented ice cream cones accidentally at a fair?
question.ms: Negara manakah secara tidak sengaja mencipta kon ais krim di sebuah pameran?

funFact.en: A waffle vendor rolled waffles into cones when a seller ran out of bowls.
funFact.ms: Penjual waffle menggulung waffle menjadi kon apabila penjual ais krim kehabisan mangkuk.

question.en: Which animal has square-shaped poop?
question.ms: Haiwan manakah mempunyai najis berbentuk segi empat?

funFact.en: Cube-shaped poop helps it stay in place on rocks.
funFact.ms: Najis berbentuk kiub membantu ia kekal di atas batu.

question.en: Which planet spins sideways compared to others?
question.ms: Planet manakah berputar secara mengiring berbanding planet lain?

funFact.en: Uranus rotates on its side at about 98 degrees.
funFact.ms: Uranus berputar pada sudut kira-kira 98 darjah.

question.en: Which animal's milk is pink due to special pigments?
question.ms: Haiwan manakah mempunyai susu berwarna merah jambu kerana pigmen khas?

funFact.en: Hippos produce reddish secretions sometimes called 'blood sweat'.
funFact.ms: Badak air menghasilkan rembesan kemerahan yang kadang-kadang dipanggil 'peluh darah'.

question.en: Which element is the most abundant in the universe?
question.ms: Unsur manakah paling banyak di alam semesta?

funFact.en: Hydrogen makes up about 75% of the universe's normal matter.
funFact.ms: Hidrogen membentuk kira-kira 75% jirim biasa alam semesta.

question.en: Which animal can taste with its feet?
question.ms: Haiwan manakah boleh merasa dengan kakinya?

funFact.en: Butterflies have taste sensors on their feet.
funFact.ms: Kupu-kupu mempunyai deria rasa pada kakinya.

question.en: Which planet has a day longer than its year?
question.ms: Planet manakah mempunyai satu hari lebih panjang daripada setahunnya?

funFact.en: Venus rotates so slowly that one day lasts longer than a full orbit around the Sun.
funFact.ms: Zuhrah berputar sangat perlahan sehingga satu hari lebih lama daripada satu orbit mengelilingi Matahari.
